blocks.rationale: Create a narrowly scoped §3306(c)(5) helper so family-employment claims are evaluated under the applicable family-relationship rule instead of the unrelated domestic-service rule. A categorical relationship input also permits short-circuit evaluation when the worker's age is absent but an unconditionally covered relationship is known.

inputs.name: employer_relationship_to_worker
inputs.question: What family relationship of the employing person to the individual performing the service is stated in the current facts, expressed as son, daughter, spouse, father, mother, or none?

inputs.name: worker_age
inputs.question: What age of the individual performing the service is expressly stated in the current facts?

inputs.name: question_asserts_section_applies
inputs.question: Does the current question affirm, rather than deny, that section 3306(c)(5) applies to the described service?

skill.intent: Determine whether a claim that 26 U.S.C. §3306(c)(5) applies to service performed in a specified family employment relationship is entailed or contradicted.

outputs.description: The current native answer label: Entailment if the asserted applicability matches §3306(c)(5), otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: covered_relationships_without_age_condition

origin.quote: service performed by an individual in the employ of his son, daughter, or spouse

premises.question: Which relationships of the employer to the worker trigger §3306(c)(5)(A) without an age condition?

premises.name: covered_parent_relationships

origin.quote: service performed by a child under the age of 21 in the employ of his father or mother

premises.question: Which relationships of the employer to the worker are governed by the child-age condition in §3306(c)(5)(B)?

premises.name: child_age_limit

origin.quote: service performed by a child under the age of 21 in the employ of his father or mother

premises.question: What exclusive upper age limit governs the child-in-parent's-employ rule in §3306(c)(5)(B)?

origin.quote: (A) service performed by an individual in the employ of his son, daughter, or spouse; (B) service performed by a child under the age of 21 in the employ of his father or mother;

source_obligations.statement: Check whether the employer is the worker's son, daughter, or spouse, or whether the worker is under age 21 and the employer is the worker's father or mother.
